 McKenna Grace Serves Gothic Glam in Daring Lace Minidress Straight Out of Britney Spears' 2001 VMAs Era
 McKenna Grace goes from Panem to pop princess glamour in a lace that reminds us of Britney
By 
 KD Rossly 
 Published Nov 13 2026, 10:25 AM GMT Share on Twitter 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on WhatsApp 
 McKenna Grace wears Annie's Ibiza's Spiritus lace minidress at Cultured magazine’s Artists on Artists dinner in Los Angeles, California 
 @mckennagraceful/Instagram 
 Oops! She did it again. McKenna Grace has delivered another memorable red carpet coup, this time channelling the rebellious glamour of Britney Spears' early-2000s wardrobe. The actress donned a sheer black lace minidress that gave us deju vu linked to the 2001 MTV Video Music Awards red carpet.
 Grace attended Cultured magazine's Artists on Artists dinner in Los Angeles on 10 November, wearing Annie's Ibiza's Spiritus dress. The gothic-inspired ensemble featured intricate floral embellishments, a daring sheer silhouette, and a matching lace choker. It was a dramatic departure from the elaborately elegant gowns associated with her recent Hunger Games appearances.
 Accompanying the 20-year-old actress were Joseph Zada, her co-star in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , and Maxwell Jenkins, her fellow mystery-solver in Netflix's upcoming Scooby-Doo: Origins . Between Panem, Mystery Inc., and a wardrobe worthy of pop royalty, Grace is having herself a no-fail November. Her fashion game is definitely volunteering as tribute.
 McKenna Grace Gives Gothic Glam a Britney Spears Twist 
 Styled by Molly Dickson, Grace wore the Spiritus dress from Annie's Ibiza, a £1,295 design featuring hand-placed botanical embellishments inspired by the frescoes of Venetian palazzos.
 View this post on Instagram 
 The unlined dress combines a sheer base with intricate beadwork, long fitted sleeves, a scalloped hem, and a square neckline. A matching lace choker completed the design, while Christian Louboutin pumps kept the styling sleek. Evidently, Renaissance-inspired embroidery and early-2000s pop-star glamour make surprisingly good company.
 The outfit also bears a striking resemblance to Britney Spears' infamous 2001 VMAs look. The pop icon wore a sheer black Dolce & Gabbana lace dress with visible black lingerie underneath, creating one of the evening's most memorable looks.
 Grace's version is more intricately embellished, but the shared combination of sheer black lace, lingerie-inspired styling, and unapologetic confidence makes the common denominator difficult to ignore.
 Britney Spears Biopic Perhaps?
 The resemblance comes at an interesting time for Spears' forthcoming biopic, which Universal Pictures is developing from the singer's memoir, The Woman in Me . Directed by Jon M. Chu, with a screenplay by Liz Meriwether, the film will explore the pop star's life and career.
 However, the production has yet to announce who will portray the famous pop princess. In September, Chu explained that casting was not yet his priority, as the creative team remained focused on developing the story.

 Grace has not been announced as a candidate for the role. Still, from her blonde waves to black lace and early-2000s styling, it's easy to wonder whether the casting team might appreciate a little red-carpet inspiration.
 From The Hunger Games to Scooby-Doo, Grace Has a Busy Year Ahead 
 McKenna Grace's wave of method dressing is tied to her on-screen projects. She stars as Maysilee Donner in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , alongside Joseph Zada as a young Haymitch Abernathy. The highly anticipated prequel arrives in cinemas on 20 November, giving audiences a journey back into Panem's past.
 Grace also appeared at the dinner with Maxwell Jenkins, who plays Fred Jones opposite her Daphne Blake in Netflix's upcoming live-action series Scooby-Doo: Origins . Set for release in 2027, the series follows a younger Mystery Inc. as its members become entangled in a supernatural mystery involving a lost Great Dane.
 That makes the dinner an unofficial franchise crossover, with a Hunger Games tribute and two future mystery-solvers sharing the same fashionable evening.
 With Panem on her itinerary and mysteries waiting to be solved, Grace already has plenty on her plate. Still, if Britney Spears' biopic ever needs a leading lady, some fans are already looking in McKenna Grace's direction. After all, when it comes to serving looks, the next one is always stronger than yesterday.
